conflicts.claim_as_written: The bigger call: we're going to build an internal evaluation harness from scratch for the noisy-label work - controlled noise injection (uniform and asymmetric), per-noise-ratio eval matrices, seed management, and re-weighting diagnostics like weight-distribution tracking. [...] Chiara owns it at 70% with Emeka at 50%; roughly seven weeks, harness stable by mid-June so the FSR comparison runs on it.
